notes.title: BE HUNTED 3R RELEASE UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello !
Back with some news for this 3R update !

Last part of the 2R Update is now avaible !
We Release the Killer AI [UNSTABLE] !
We have worked alots to provide player achievements, customization, characters buy system, lobby customization, screamers and more !

UPDATE 3R

Now lets talk about the update ! Alots of major fix and new contents ! ːsteammockingː And if you encounter any bugs please help us over here : https://discord.gg/tsCJtNFVbP

MAP

 New map Pyscho House, very little map, for 1 player this map will only spawn the new killer AI with the KILLER UPDATE. You can find him at the beginning after he spawn depending of your difficulty.


GAMEPLAY

 Host can now choose which map he want to play on lobby.
 You see now your room name in the lobby.
 Added Screamer [BETA] You can desactivate them in MainMenu/Settings. (For now we use third party screamer but we are working on handmade screamer not 2D).
 Added Random scary sound for more ambient.
 Added dead animation for local and network player.
 Removed new door system was buggy.
 You can now unlock Characters, Walls, Floor for your game and show it to your friends !
 Added Killer AI, for now very unstable but working great, if you see him just run..
 Puzzles now disappear after completed them.
 Added Difficulty System.
 Fix alots of bugs in game.


DIFFICULTY SYSTEM
EASY

 Ghost/Killer can spawn after 360 seconds.
 You win 50$ for puzzle exit, and 150$ for puzzle exit with ghost killed.
 You win 100XP for puzzle exit, and 200XP for puzzle exit with ghost killed.
 You unlock this difficulty at level 0.

MEDIUM

 Ghost/Killer can spawn after 160 seconds.
 You win 100$ for puzzle exit, and 300$ for puzzle exit with ghost killed.
 You win 100XP for puzzle exit, and 200XP for puzzle exit with ghost killed.
 You unlock this difficulty at level 10.

HARDCORE

 Ghost/Killer can spawn after 60 seconds.
 You win 200$ for puzzle exit, and 500$ for puzzle exit with ghost killed.
 You win 100XP for puzzle exit, and 200XP for puzzle exit with ghost killed.
 You unlock this difficulty at level 50.


WORKING ON

ITEMS

 Placeable Camera in scene, still have some bugs with it.


GHOST

 AI Hide system.
 Killer AI better ai.


GAMEPLAY

 Add correct steam achievement.
 Thermometer Temperature system need to be fixed.
 UV Lamp in progress.
 When switch back to flashlight from spirit box, voice still come from spirit box, very spooky..


MAP

 Working on the new gameplay map : Retro House.

notes.title: BE HUNTED 1R RELEASE UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello !
Back with some news for this 1R update !

First let's talk about the game we have release yesterday.
To be clear, the game is in a "Playable" stage.
If you except to play the game and have fun like a finish game don't buy it righ now, wait 2 weeks maybe and keep an eyes on Be Hunted you will be surprise.

ːsteamthumbsupː Thanks for all good review, we are gonna work very hard to upload and patch contents !

ːsteamthumbsdownː Thanks for your feedbacks, we read everythings and gonna work more harder to publish a more "Playable" game.

ːsteamthisː For everyone that want to buy the game. If you want to buy it for a less price and if you want to talk with us to improve and add your idea you can right now. For everyone that want a stable game with alots of content similar to "Phasmophobia" don't buy the game and wait a little more longer. ːsteamthisː

notes.title: BE HUNTED POST-RELEASE 1F
notes.content:
Hello !
First we would like to thank you. Thank you for believing in BE HUNTED.
First I would like to talk about BE HUNTED update 1F.

UPDATE 1F

We don't want to release all the game content at the first day, we have a lots to release after 21 December. We are right now working hard to patch all Game Breaking Bugs. 
Here is a little list of things added or patch between steam store release and today :

AI

 Ghost now can have random mesh, up to 9 different ghost mesh right now.
 Ghost now can target the player directly after killed your friend.
 New animations added, better coming next week after release.
 Hunter in progress, coming next week after release.


MAP

 New map for Tutorial Scenario.
 New audio voice acting for Tutorial.
 Abandoned House map is now working perfectly.
 Hotel map rework in progress, coming next week after release.
 Haunted Residential House is currently on progress.
 Haunted Work Office is currently on progress.
 Added 2 gameplay difference : Haunted Place, Abandoned Place.
 Haunted Place have no puzzle, but things to find for exit. More focus on ghost, also no hunter in it.
 Abandoned Place have puzzles, hunter can spawn in.


GAMEPLAY

 Male character hand animation done.
 Female character still have bugs, it's in progress to be added for release.
 Ritual Zone Added.
 When Ritual Zone successful, for now you hear a ghost scream and objectives updated. You also win double money and double xp for now.
 When Ritual Zone failed, for now you get into the ghost world and get killed by the ghost.
 There is currently 43 pre-made puzzles, very simple one, some are bugged but a Puzzle Update is coming post release.
 Items now up to 6 in the shop scene, use now Weak Lamp, Battery, EMF, Spirit Box, Thermometer, Writing Book. More coming post release.
 Added text on Main Menu, displaying general information, time before next update.
 Player Pref is now saved.
 Photon Pun 2 updated, player get disconnected after exit the game, lobby no more displaying after the game launched, added self-hosting for Photon, added more CCU for release.
 You have now to play the Tutorial, before playing Multiplayer.
 Flappy Happy Arcade Lobby, score is now saved, beat your friend !
 Added item level, you have to be level 5 in order to buy Placeable Camera (coming post release still have bug in it), Thermometer.
 Added Steam Achievement.



WORKING ON

ITEMS

 Placeable Camera in scene.
 Crucifix to have some time before the ghost kill you. 
 Photo Camera to take picture of you, your friend and.. the ghost maybe ?


GHOST

 Fix bug that instantly target player when starting the game, very spooky ..
 Fix animation problem not playing.


GAMEPLAY

 Add correct steam achievement.
 Patch Hotel scene.
 Ghost Footstep not playing correctly.
 Ritual Scream not playing correctly.
 Finish Zone not spawning after making 3 puzzles.
 Spirit Book not working.
 Thermometer Temperature system need to be fixed.
 UV Lamp in progress.
 Talk to the ghost actually is just to trigger the ghost more frequently, make him more aggressive, but still need to add more.
 When exit puzzle mouse cursor not lock.
 When switch back to flashlight from spirit box, voice still come from spirit box, very spooky..
 Need to deactivate light when exit puzzle or when finished.


MAP

 Working on the new gameplay map : Working Office, Residential House.
